display.purpose: Page titles, route codes, and decision headlines.

data.purpose: Prices, points, taxes, seats, timestamps, and program codes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action with a compact operational shape.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #80a8a5); color: var(--bg, #031820); padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #80a8a5); border-radius: 4px; font: 600 0.875rem 'Outfit', sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #bcd2cf); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #80a8a5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Route Input
components.description: Airport-code input with a strong focus state.
components.css: .ds-route-input { width: 7rem; background: var(--surface, #072530); color: var(--text, #ecdfc0); border: 1px solid var(--border, #1a4a52); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; font: 500 0.875rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-route-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #80a8a5); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--accent, #80a8a5); }

components.name: Mode Switch
components.css: .ds-mode { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; background: var(--surface, #072530); border: 1px solid var(--border, #1a4a52); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-mode button { border: 0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #d4a574); font: 500 0.875rem 'Outfit', sans-serif; } .ds-mode button:hover { color: var(--text, #ecdfc0); } .ds-mode button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #80a8a5); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-mode .ds-mode-active { background: var(--elevated, #0e3640); color: var(--accent, #80a8a5); }

components.name: Availability Chip
components.description: Seat availability label with text and semantic color.
components.css: .ds-availability { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #10b981; border-radius: 999px; color: #10b981; background: rgba(16,185,129,0.08); font: 500 0.75rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; }

components.name: Comparison Row
components.css: .ds-ledger { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(12rem,1fr) minmax(10rem,1fr) auto; gap: 16px; align-items: center; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #1a4a52); color: var(--text, #ecdfc0); font: 400 0.875rem 'Outfit', sans-serif; } .ds-ledger strong { color: var(--accent, #80a8a5); font: 600 0.875rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-ledger span:last-child { color: var(--text-secondary, #d4a574); font: 500 0.75rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; }

narrative.overview: Flight Finder combines a quiet operational surface with the character of a mid-century airline timetable. Information arrives in a strong reading order: route, decision, evidence, action. Simple mode keeps the runway clear. Analyst mode increases density through aligned columns and comparison controls while preserving the same component vocabulary.
keyCharacteristics: Progressive disclosure between Simple and Analyst modes

rules.name: Signal Rarity
rules.body: Semantic colors appear only where they convey fare direction, availability, warning, or success.

rules.name: Numeric Alignment
rules.body: Prices, points, taxes, seat counts, and timestamps use the mono face with tabular alignment.

rules.name: Grounded Surface
rules.body: At-rest content remains flat; elevation appears only when interaction or layering requires it.

dos: Do place route, dates, and cabin before derived recommendations.
Do show source, observation time, and cached status beside each result.
Do preserve cash, miles, and taxes as separate values.
Do use semantic color with text or icon labels.
Do let users switch modes without losing their search or filters.
donts: Don't assemble the page from interchangeable dashboard cards.
Don't hide taxes, freshness, or the booking program behind a deal score.
Don't expose every analyst filter before the user chooses Analyst mode.
Don't use purple gradients, amber-primary palettes, glass panels, gradient text, or colored side-stripe borders.
Don't imply cached award availability is guaranteed; direct users to confirm with the airline before transferring points.
